points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench with explicit external paths; CTest finds no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses case, output and control overrides and rejects invalid flux; no full case rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, distribution, physics, solver and output modules are distinct, although fixed 2-D state remains.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal solver executable wrapper identified in source; external similarity investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON selects mesh/physics/BC; cgns_mesh reader accepts supported unstructured sections rather than two fixed filenames.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root-only global mesh, METIS K-way, neighbor halo and reductions; exact binary/start match for rank comparisons is unbound.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity fallback and finite checks present; unsupported CGNS sections are silently skipped and environment switches affect reconstruction.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight output layouts passed validator; isolated clean build succeeded, but CTest registers no tests and no unsteady run was repeated.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modular source, contestant run scripts and manifest; historical runtime binary and environment are unbound.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
